videos.title: Christmas in the Air
videos.description: When professional organiser Lydia meets frazzled Robert, she has only 12 days to help him get his life in order before his big Christmas pitch.

videos.title: Snowbound for Christmas
videos.description: A few days before Christmas, Rachel, an assistant and in love with her boss Adrian, accompanies him on a trip. A storm blocks them in a five-star hotel where they are the only guests. It's the perfect opportunity to get closer.

videos.title: Planes, Trains, and Christmas Trees
videos.description: An event planner and a sports agent are determined to make it back home by Christmas Eve when their flight is cancelled, and they decide to team up.

videos.title: Christmas Connection
videos.description: Stewardess Sydney is tasked with looking after Leah, an unaccompanied minor. After Leah safely arrives, Sydney finds a package Leah left behind and decides to deliver it. When she misses her connection, she is invited to spend the holidays with them.

videos.title: Grounded for Christmas
videos.description: When a winter storm hits Cleveland and grounds flights, the nearby hotels quickly fill up with stranded travellers. Nina, a pilot, reluctantly agrees to let her arrogant but charming fellow pilot, Brady, stay at her nearby parents' home.

videos.title: Snowed in for Christmas
videos.description: A snowstorm derails au pair Kaley's plans to go home for the holidays, so she becomes determined to teach the girls she watches about the magic of Christmas.

videos.title: Christmas in Evergreen: Letters to Santa
videos.description: When Lisa returns home for Christmas to find her town's beloved general store has closed, she rallies the community to save the shop.

videos.title: Christmas Wishes & Mistletoe Kisses
videos.description: Abbey is hired to decorate the estate of businessman Nick. She must break down the wall between the two of them while keeping the holiday spirit alive.

videos.title: Destination Christmas
videos.description: A woman's holiday plans go disastrously wrong when she mistakenly winds up in St. John, Alaska, during Christmastime. However, things take a turn for the better when she meets a local man who sweeps her off her feet.

videos.description: Interior designer Reilly finds herself this Christmas in the town of Mistletoe Lake with no place to stay. She accepts an offer from Ray to stay on his boat and helps him renovate it for the town's Christmas Harbor Festival.
